title: Rav Chanania Aryeh Baron Passes
body: Rav Chanania Aryeh Baron zt”l, 91, rabbi of Yeshiva Beit El in Yerushalayim's Old City, passed away on Shabbos.

title: Ger Rebbe Cancels UTJ Meeting
body: The UTJ's Agudas Yisroel faction meeting to discuss the draft law was canceled due to the Gerer Rebbe's medical condition. The Rebbe didn't participate in tefillos over Shabbos, prompting the cancellation.
